description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pituwala, Elpitiya D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810755
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land titles for multiple parcels in Pituwala village. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership details, extents, and property characteristics. The content falls squarely under land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4, with no government personnel changes or structural administrative changes that would trigger Types 1-3.
